question: Can compact-time uniform convergence of the unchanged PAH finite stationary correlations to the R-512 minimal-form correlation be reduced to convergence on finite time meshes plus the R-543 finite modulus and target continuity?

scope.finite_family: C_(n,j)(f,g;t) from unchanged PAH-001 after the registered j-before-anchored-n order.
scope.target: C_inf(f,g;t)=<f,T_min(t)g> for the exact R-512 minimal closed-form spectral semigroup from R-530.
scope.observable: One fixed local cylinder pair f,g after support stabilization.
scope.time: External stochastic Markov time t in a fixed compact interval [0,T] only.
scope.comparison: Scalar correlation comparison only; no new U_n, carrier, conditional averaging or path process is introduced.

hypotheses.finite_modulus: There is M_fg independent of retained finite n,j such that |C_(n,j)(t)-C_(n,j)(s)| <= M_fg |t-s|; R-543 supplies M_fg=sqrt(B_f B_g) under its finite form-energy hypotheses.
hypotheses.target_continuity: The fixed R-512 target correlation C_inf is uniformly continuous on [0,T]; R-530's spectral semigroup supplies continuity for each fixed Hilbert-space pair, but no finite-to-target identification is inferred.
hypotheses.mesh_cover: For every delta>0, a finite mesh G_delta subset of [0,T] has covering radius at most delta.
hypotheses.mesh_pointwise: For every fixed delta and every mesh point q in G_delta, the ordered j-before-anchored-n correlation error tends to zero. This is the remaining dynamic input, not proved by this contract.

bound: sup_(0<=t<=T)|C_(n,j)(t)-C_inf(t)| <= max_(q in G_delta)|C_(n,j)(q)-C_inf(q)| + M_fg*delta + omega_inf(delta), where omega_inf(delta)=sup_{|t-s|<=delta}|C_inf(t)-C_inf(s)|.
ordered_conclusion: If the mesh-pointwise hypothesis holds for every delta and the ordered limit is taken j->infinity at fixed n followed by anchored n, then the compact-time supremum tends to zero by first choosing delta with M_fg*delta+omega_inf(delta) small and then taking the ordered limit on the finite mesh.
verification_requirements: Primary exact-rational mesh inequality and ordered-limit bookkeeping.
Independent non-importing mesh fixtures with a different target modulus.
Hostile checks rejecting omission of target continuity, coverage radius, finite modulus or the registered order.
Lean finite rational inequality for the mesh transfer; no infinite-volume theorem is formalized.

acceptance.PASS: The scalar mesh inequality and conditional ordered implication replay identically in all finite verification lanes.
acceptance.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: The actual PAH mesh-pointwise convergence, common-space/path-space packet and R-512 identification remain absent.
acceptance.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact failure of the scalar mesh inequality under its stated hypotheses would be negative; no such failure is expected.

single_next_question: Can a source-authorized common-space or path-space packet prove the ordered correlation convergence at every finite time mesh point for the unchanged PAH-001 dynamics?
non_claims: No PAH mesh-pointwise convergence is assumed as an achieved result; it remains the missing dynamic input.
No common U_n, path law, non-explosion theorem, N2b/N2c/N4/N2d closure or R-512 finite-to-target identification.
No replacement of PAH-001 functional, rates, Gibbs state, external Markov time or j-before-anchored-n order.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
